headline: Screamer documentation corrected: diving does not kill the enemy
summary: Contributor documentation now correctly says the Screamer retreats to its spawn point after diving at its target. It dies only when lethal damage exhausts its health, so this is a comment correction rather than a gameplay change. PAL v2.00 remains at 100% matched code and 5,116 of 5,116 functions in the project's progress report. Matching means compiling to exactly the original game's bytes.
highlights: The generated-name readability proposal closed without merging (#161).
New reports describe Linux visual glitches and launcher freezes in OpenRAC 0.10.0 (#162, #164), request headphone and speaker surround support (#163), and report a disc extraction failure (#165).
